About three kilometers from Barasat city is the 400-year-old Kali Temple of Raghu Dakat. According to folklore, Raghu Dakat used to worship here before going on a robbery and distribute the loot among the poor. Currently, there is no idol or priest in the temple. Goddess Kali is worshipped amidst a huge Ashvatth tree and broken bricks. Special pujas are organized here during Amavasya and Kali Puja.
